controls.preregistered: addendum section 3, unchanged, plus section 3g.6's two structural controls (stratum L positive on the pipeline, stratum H against the monotone-in-|s| reading)
controls.rule: FIRED AS PLANTED := P recovered AND N did not recover AND (R recovered, if R ran)

P.planted: the exact fixed point of the discrete map, in closed form: w*_hat = dt*forcing_hat*decay/(1-decay). ||Phi_dt(w*)-w*|| = 7.6e-14 and ||Phi_T(w*)-w*|| = 2.35e-13 at T=19.33, so the extended residual there is an exact zero
P.exercises: the state block ONLY -- at a relative equilibrium ||dR/ds|| = 0 exactly and dR/dT is negligible (M1's rank deficiency of 2); T and s are exercised by control R

N.planted: a phase-scrambled field: the amplitude spectrum of a real candidate (so energy and enstrophy are a genuine turbulent state's, by Parseval) with random phases, so it lies near no orbit; seeded with a period from the Table IV anchor band
N.guards: the matching predicate firing spuriously, which would turn a `no` into a false `yes`

R.role: POSITIVE, conditional -- MUST SUCCEED IF IT RUNS
R.planted: a converged orbit from this run (anchor UPO37), perturbed
R.exercises: the state block AND T and s -- neither is degenerate at a genuine RPO, which is what P cannot test

resourcing.workers_note: 8, not U3's 10: a measured contention probe on this 6-core machine put throughput at 3.11/3.22/2.91/2.75 eval/s at 6/8/10/12 workers, so U3 ran past the optimum -- the mechanism erratum (ii) suspected
resourcing.scheduling: imap_unordered chunksize=1, which repairs erratum (i) (Pool.map chunking left U3's tail worker 12 attempts) and is what makes progress reporting possible

options_not_taken.d_buy_iterations: NOT TAKEN -- caps identical to U3; U5 spends FEWER epochs via the validated stall exit

seed.ban1: PASS - no step continues a fixed point into an orbit
seed.ban2: PASS - every attempt anchored to a named row; an unanchored attempt would STOP and escalate, not report

rule.statement: take EVERY anchored strict local minimum of R_red with R_red < R_THRES_WINDOW; no ranking, no truncation, no per_anchor
rule.why_not_stratified_at_the_prefilter: R_red is built from amplitude spectra and is shift-invariant by construction -- the same invariance that makes the prefilter lossless -- so |s| does not exist at this stage and cannot be stratified on here. Period can be and was (AMENDMENT 4); shift is stratified downstream in the budget.
rule.lossless_prune: R_red <= R pointwise (the prefilter's own recorded statement), so R_red >= 0.25 provably cannot have R < 0.25 and is already outside the Newton window. Dropping it discards no admissible seed.

regeneration_checks.scheme: block-parallel replay from the stored complex128 checkpoints; a scheduling change, not a numerical one

realization.finding: unchanged from U3: the stepper is a Lie-Trotter split, FIRST order in time (measured global ratio 2.00), and the extended residual carries a continuous x-shift only, so the m != 0 class cannot be expressed as a seed
realization.lesson_91: any negative this unit reports carries both clauses, plus its own: the seed pool is now shift-STRATIFIED rather than shift-biased, which is the one thing that changed
